title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
blurb: TUNG TUNG TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR — the hypnotic drum chant from Indonesia's sahur wake-up tradition, transformed by the internet into one of the defining Italian brainrot characters. The rhythm is relentless, the AI-generated wooden creature is unsettling, and together they colonized every For You page on Earth. If you've heard it once, it's already living in your head rent-free.
origin: From Indonesian sahur drum-calling tradition; became a cornerstone Italian brainrot character.
